dct_description_sm: Population Raster Guam 2020 Data Input: Settlement footprint from Facebook's High-Resolution Population Density Maps https://data.humdata.org/dataset/guam-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates Population allocated proportionally using 2011 census population counts at district level. Year Population Growth Rate of 1.64% has been applied to update population up to 2020 The human settlement footprint with census population allocated has been converted into a 100 m resolution raster. _Access this dataset from the [Pacific Data Hub](https://pacificdata.org/data/dataset/gum_population_grid_2020)_
